changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to title case, merged duplicate dataset entries, removed model variations that are essentially the same as base models (Transformer structural encoder/decoder are just applications of Transformer), and simplified outputs to the core description.
Simplified metric variants to base forms as per guidelines (BLEU-1/BLEU-2 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE)
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses human evaluation but not LLM-based evaluation.

guideline: verify whether the caption phrase correctly describes the functionality and purpose of the element

changes_made.explanation: The extracted metadata accurately captures the human evaluation criteria described in the paper.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper presents a novel NLG task (widget captioning) that is analogous to image captioning but for UI elements. It uses standard automatic metrics and conducts human evaluation. No LLM-based evaluation was used. The models mentioned are primarily Transformer and ResNet architectures for multimodal encoding.
